definitions.explanation: A political system in which power is vested in the people, who rule either directly or through elected representatives.

examples.japanese: {民主主義|みんしゅしゅぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧。
{民主主義|みんしゅしゅぎ}⟦{国家|こっか}→国家：02760_kokka⟧。
{民主主義|みんしゅしゅぎ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{基本|きほん}→基本：00226_kihon⟧⟦{原則|げんそく}→原則：11801_gensoku⟧。

notes:
{民主主義|みんしゅしゅぎ} is the standard term for democracy as a political ideology and system of government. The word is composed of ⟦{民主|みんしゅ}→民主：06028_minshu⟧ (people's sovereignty) + ⟦{主義|しゅぎ}→主義：03215_shugi⟧ (-ism).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {民主主義|みんしゅしゅぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧: to protect democracy
- {民主主義|みんしゅしゅぎ}⟦{国家|こっか}→国家：02760_kokka⟧: a democratic nation
- {民主主義|みんしゅしゅぎ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原則|げんそく}→原則：11801_gensoku⟧: principles of democracy

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{民主的|みんしゅてき}→民主的：noentry⟧: democratic (na-adjective, used to describe processes or attitudes)
- ⟦{民主化|みんしゅか}→民主化：13230_minshuka⟧: democratization
- ⟦{直接|ちょくせつ}→直接：03499_chokusetsu⟧{民主主義|みんしゅしゅぎ}: direct democracy
- ⟦{間接|かんせつ}→間接：00180_kansetsu⟧{民主主義|みんしゅしゅぎ}: representative democracy

SIMILAR WORDS:
Opposed to ⟦{独裁|どくさい}→独裁：05969_dokusai⟧ (dictatorship) and ⟦{専制|せんせい}→専制：17739_sensei⟧⟦{政治|せいじ}→政治：01629_seiji⟧ (autocracy). {民主主義|みんしゅしゅぎ} emphasizes the ideology, while ⟦{民主|みんしゅ}→民主：06028_minshu⟧⟦{政治|せいじ}→政治：01629_seiji⟧ refers specifically to democratic governance as a system.
